metadata.datasource: ILFORD SFX 200 fact sheet (April 2004): spectral sensitivity from the vector paths (p1); its characteristic curve from the November 2018 SFX 200 technical information (p2, a raster image traced at 600 dpi: ID-11 stock, 10 min, 20 C), the 2004 sheet having none. Copies from 125px.com's archive of ILFORD documents.

tags.log_sensitivity: SHEET 354-774 nm: the SFX 200 curve of the "wedge spectrogram to tungsten light (2850K)" (the sheet also draws a "conventional film") taken as drawn; ASSUMED its 0-1 "Sensitivity" axis is log units and the source is not divided out (as HP5 Plus); extended red sensitivity to about 740 nm; ASSUMED held below 354 nm, ASSUMED log-linear tail -0.0200 dex/nm above 774 nm; scale MEASURED so grey 0.184 -> raw 1
tags.density_curves: SHEET for log_exposure -1.95..2.36 (ID-11 stock, 10 min, 20 C: the one curve the sheet plots; slope 0.3-1.5 over base+fog 0.698); ASSUMED flat toe below, ASSUMED straight line slope 0.241 into a ceiling of gross D 3.0 above
tags.log_exposure_anchor: ASSUMED: the sheet's exposure axis is relative. 0 = one log unit above the curve's own D = base+fog + 0.1 point, i.e. the film is taken to have exactly its rated speed (ISO 200: log10(0.8/200)+1.0 = -1.398 log lux-s)
tags.channel_density: ASSUMED: neutral silver, 1/3 per channel at every wavelength
tags.density_curves_layers: ASSUMED: three-CDF fit of the curve (max fit error 0.0227 D), no sheet data on emulsion sub-layers
